description: OGC-API Features Feuerwehrleitstellen in NRW (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc-api.nrw.de. The districts and district-free cities in North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW) maintain control centres for the consultation of emergency calls in the event of fires or medical emergencies via the emergency number 112. They coordinate the resulting operations and dispatch the necessary resources from the fire brigade, emergency services and civil protection. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "OGC-API Features Fire Stations in NRW (INSPIRE)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Rettungsleitstellen, Feuerwehrleitstelle, inspireidentifiziert, Notruf, Leitstellenverzeichnis, Feuerwehr. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
